data.name: Xanthera
data.gender_notes: Xanthera is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Xanthera was a goddess of the sun, identified with the Greek god Helios. Her name is derived from the Greek word 'xanthis', meaning 'yellow'. Xanthera was believed to bring prosperity, happiness, and good fortune. The name Xanthera carries the meaning “Yellow Goddess” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Xanthera usually hope their child will grow to embody yellow goddess and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Xanthera total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
